thread:
Maya (Design): Quick design review — trying a smaller 'role card' variant inside the invite drawer. Main concerns: focus trap when keyboard-traversing, SSO status pill placement, and the 'Invite' CTA disabled-state microcopy. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/s/roles-drawer-v2.png :eyes:

Jon (Frontend): Looks good. Noted the focus trap — when drawer opens, focus should go to first interactive item (role checkbox). Current prototype traps on container. I can change JS to move focus to .role-checkbox-0. Also the role pills overflow; might need tabindex tweaks.

Sam (A11y): Agree with Jon. Also the 'SSO enforced' pill needs better semantics — it can flip after an API check. Suggest aria-live and aria-atomic on a small status region, and ensure the pill meets color-contrast (current light blue on white fails AA at 12px). Recommend a filled pill or darker border.

Lucy (PM): From product POV: CTA copy should be contextual. If SSO isn't enabled for the org, CTA stays 'Invite' and helper text explains why enforcement can't be toggled. If SSO is enabled, CTA can read 'Invite & enforce SSO'. Keep the helper text short.

Maya (Design): Thinking of adding a one-line hint under the CTA: 'SSO enforcement applies org-wide — invites will auto-require SSO'. Concerned about density though, maybe make it a 'Learn more' link to docs.

Oliver (Design Ops): Tooltip sounds ok visually, but tooltips are tricky for keyboard users. Prefer a small helper link that launches a modal with the one-liner + link to docs. Modal is better for discoverability and accessible focus handling.

Jon (Frontend): Implementation note: tooltip + keyboard-accessible link is doable, but if we go modal I'll wire focus management with focus-trap and ensure escape closes. Also watch for scroll jumps when the role list changes height (role chips wrap).

Sam (A11y): Please use role="dialog" + aria-modal="true" for the drawer. Ensure initial focus lands on the first interactive element and that focus returns to the trigger button on close. Test with NVDA and Safari VoiceOver. Also, add a visible focus indicator for role chips (keyboard users need a clear focus ring).

CI Bot: deploy-preview:roles-drawer-v2 built — https://staging.redwood/preview/roles-drawer-v2 (checksum: abc123) :white_check_mark:

Jon (Frontend): Ran axe on preview, flagged 3 issues: 1) color-contrast (SSO pill), 2) focus order (close button placed after role list), 3) missing accessible name on remove icons for role chips (empty button title).

Maya (Design): I'll darken the pill and move the remove icon into a labeled control. For the helper copy, I'll shorten to one sentence and add a 'Learn more' link that opens the modal.

Lucy (PM): Add analytics events while we're here: invite_drawer_open, invite_role_changed, invite_submit_sso. Need counts to see if people try to toggle SSO then hit disabled CTA.

Sam (A11y): Small nit: keyboard users expect Esc to close the drawer — please keep that. Also ensure the live region announces form errors on submit, e.g., 'Invite failed: user already exists.'

Jon (Frontend): Pushed a branch and opened PR #4572 with fixes for focus order, aria labels on remove buttons, and updated pill colors. Will add automated axe check in CI and a unit test to assert focus lands on .role-checkbox-0.

Maya (Design): Thanks! Quick decision: go modal + helper link (no tooltip). I'll update Figma and post an updated screenshot in this thread once done.

Oliver (Design Ops): FYI, when you post the new image tag please include alt text for the screenshot in the PR description so designers and QA running with screen readers can validate.

Lucy (PM): Timeline: aim to ship next sprint if no regressions. If a11y blockers remain, we'll push.

Maya (Design): Cool — will follow up. :thumbsup:
